text.body: svarabhaktilakṣaṇapariśiṣṭā śikṣā athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitām śikṣāṃ samāsatastatra svarāṃstvaṣṭau prakīrttitāḥ 1 tairovirāmaḥ kṣaipraśca tairovyañjakastathā bhāvyo'bhinihito jātyaḥ pādavṛttaśca saptamaḥ 2 praśliṣṭa iti vijñeyāḥ procyante lakṣaṇānyatha avagraha udāttaścetsvaritaḥ syāttataḥ param 3 avagrahātpadaṃ yastu taṃ vidyātprathamaṃ svaram lakṣyamasya tu vijñeyaṃ gopatāviti go | patau 4 ikārokārayoḥ sthāne yavau syātāmudāttayoḥ anudātte pade nityaṃ sa kṣipra iti kīrttitaḥ 5 tryambakaṃ dvranna ityādi lakṣyaṃ jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ svaritaṃ chandasi padaṃ yatkiñcidapi dṛśyate 6 udāttapūrvaṃ tatsarvvantairovyañjana ucyate iḍerante tathā havye kāmye ityādi darśanam 7 akāra ekodāttena repheṇāpahṛto bhavet tañcā bhinihitaṃ prāhuḥ kukkuṭo'si nidarśanam 8 vivṛttyā dṛśyate yatra svaraṃ ca svaritaṃ pade sa svaraḥ pādavṛttaḥ syātputra īdhe nidarśanam 9 yatrodātta ikāro hi nipātaikārasam̐yyutaḥ sa praśliṣṭa iti jñeyo'bhīmamityādi darśanam 10 sādau pade pare pūrvaṃ kakārānte pade sthite kasavarṇaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ bhiṣaksīsena darśanam 11 cakārānte pade tānte pūrvaṃ ca samavasthite pratyārambho na tatra syādyaccāhamiti darśanam 12 sādau pade pare pūrvaṃ ṅakārānte pade sati kasavarṇadvayaṃ tatra prāṅksoma iti darśanam 13 sādau pade pare nānte pūrve ca samavisthite tasavarṇaṃ vijānīyāttrīntsamuddrānnidarśanam 14 mādau pade pare mānte pūrvamuccārite sati masavarṇantu tatra syādimamma iti darśanam 15 padamadhye padādyanta ṛharephaiśca saṃyute yakāre jaṃ vijānīyādyuñjānetyādikaṃ yathā 16 ṭavargamantarā ṣasya khoccāramchandasīritaḥ pratyudāharaṇaṃ pṛṣṭo divīṣe ttvā nidarśanam 17 ūṣmordhvarephasyoccāraḥ saikāro halyuto na cet pitṝṇāmiha pitreṇāmityādi ca nidarśanam 18 aṃ kāraḥ syādanusvārasthāne śali ca re pare hrasvāddīrgho bhaveddīrghāddhrasvo gururatho mataḥ 19 sam̐yyoge parato haṃsa ityādi nidarśanam tām̐ saviturityādi dam̐ṣṭretyādikaṃ tathā 20 hrasvadīrghagurūccāraḥ karttavyo'tra yathākramam śal rephayorabhāvena siṃhī pratyudāhṛtiḥ 21 śareḥ pare yā nu ditī dvirbhavedrephabhāginām visargācca pare yāṃ ṛkārahīnāṃ nidarśanam 22 askannamadya kasyāścitkṛṣṇo'syā iti ca kramāt sūryastvādyauṣpitā cātha dadhātvasmāniti kramāt 23 bṛhantaḥ prastareṣṭṭheti punaḥ kkratve nidarśanam pāṇinīyasya sūtrābhyāṃ dvittvaṃ sarvatra kīrttitam 24 yavayoḥ parayoḥ sasya dvittvaṃ na syāttu chandasi vvasavastvā dhūpayantu tasya yoniṃ yathāyatham 25 halyukta ṛkārastu rekāraśchandasi smṛtaḥ pitaṇāmiti pitreṇāmityādi ca nidarśanam 26 hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ bhavetkiñcitsaṃhitāviṣaye svake halvisargayute varṇā halyutāyutake ca na 27 sapaktnānyaddhvamagghnyeti kiñciddīrgho bhavediha bhāgamprajāvatītyādau hrasvatā na tu dīrghatā 28 halyutākārasam̐yyogāditi jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ iti kātyāyanapariśiṣṭe varṇoccāraprakāraḥ sandhyaścaturdhā vijñeyā lopāgamavikārataḥ 29 prakṛttyā ca tathā tatra prathamaṃ hi nidarśanam vikārato yathā cedaṃ preṣitetyādikaṃ bhavet 30 devo vaḥ savitetyādau prakṛttyādipradarśanam ubhau svarau tayorantaḥ sandhiryatra na dṛśyate 31 sā vivṛttirbudhairjñeyā sa eveti ca paśyati eṣā caturdhā vijñeyā prathamā tu pipīlikā 32 parā pākavatī caiva tathā vatsānusāriṇī vatsānutsṛjitā caiva catasrastā vivṛttayaḥ 33 pipīlikādyantadīrghā nābbhyāsīnnidarśanam dvitīyā tūbhayā hrasvā vvina indreti darśanam 34 tṛtīyā coditā dīrghā tāsyeti nidarśanam ante caturthī dīrghā syāttānāvoḍhamaśvinā 35 svarabhaktiḥ pañcadhā syāttatrādyā kariṇī smṛtā lakāreṇa hakāreṇa sam̐yyogo yatra dṛśyate 36 kariṇī sā tu vijñeyā varhirasīti darśanam lakāreṇa hakāreṇa sam̐yyogo yatra dṛśyate 37 kurviṇī sā hi vijñeyā upavalheti paśyati rakārasya śakāreṇa sam̐yyogo yatra dṛśyate 38 hariṇī sā tu vijñeyārśasa ityādi darśanam lakāreṇa śakāreṇa sam̐yyogo yatra jāyate 39 tāṃ hariṇīṃ vijānīyācchatavalśeti darśanam rephasyātha ṣakāreṇa sam̐yyogo yatra dṛśyate 40 haṃsapādeti vijñeyā varṣo varṣīyasīti ca etallakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ svarabhaktervicakṣaṇaiḥ 41 jñātvaitanmanujo yāti brahmalokaṃ sanātanam iti kāttyāyanenaiva pariśiṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ mudā 42 iti kātyāyanoktā svarabhaktilakṣaṇapariśiṣṭaśikṣā samaptā
